# customdomain-sdk

> Official JavaScript/TypeScript client packages for customdomain.ai — let SaaS users connect
> their own custom domain (e.g. `acme.com` instead of `acme.yourapp.com`) with automatic DNS
> configuration, domain verification, and SSL certificate issuance.

This repository contains the public browser clients only (backend and infrastructure are a
separate private repository). Two packages publish to npm: `customdomain-js` (framework-agnostic
SDK, exposes `window.customdomain`) and `@customdomain/react` (React hook + component bindings
around the SDK). Both load an embeddable widget that a SaaS application mounts so its end users
can connect a domain without manual DNS work; DNS record configuration (via Domain Connect for
~30 supported registrars, or manual copy-paste instructions otherwise), verification, and ACME
certificate issuance all happen server-side.

## SDK reference

- [customdomain-js README](packages/sdk/README.md): Install, quickstart, and the full
  `window.customdomain` API — `open(config)`, `checkDomain(domain)`, `checkRecords(...)`,
  `load(config)` / `close()`, `loadSharedFlow(url)`, `purchaseDomain(...)` — and the
  `customdomain:success` / `customdomain:close` / `customdomain:step` / `customdomain:shared`
  events. Includes a `window.entri` compatibility shim for drop-in migration from Entri.
- [@customdomain/react README](packages/react/README.md): The `useCustomdomain()` hook and
  `<CustomdomainConnect>` component, with the full callback-prop-to-native-event mapping table.
- [customdomain.ai API documentation](https://app.customdomain.ai/docs): Server-side API —
  minting widget tokens, webhooks, and per-provider DNS record types.

## Optional

- [Repository](https://github.com/CUSTOM-DOMAIN-APP/customdomain-sdk): Source, CI
  (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`), and the provenance-signed release workflow
  (`.github/workflows/release.yml`) for both packages.
